properties.raw_text: Opioids have been shown to have clinically significant interactions with many medications with most interactions occurring through a pharmacokinetic route, but some drugs may also interact at a pharmacodynamic level. Pharmacokinetic interactions usually involve the inhibition or induction of hepatic cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes. Pharmacodynamic interactions may involve additive (CNS) depression.
